name: Street Sign Work Orders
description:
This dataset contains records of street sign work orders, likely from a municipal transportation agency, covering sign installation, replacement, and related maintenance across five boroughs. Each row represents a single work order tied to a specific sign type and location, with fields describing the order number, whether the record is historical or current, the order type prefix, borough, and the streets involved (on, from, and to streets, plus suffixes and side of street). It also captures completion dates, sign codes and descriptions, sign size, design void dates, placement details such as distance from the intersection and location corner, arrow and facing directions, sheeting type, support type, free-text notes, and X/Y map coordinates.

The data spans many years, with completion dates ranging from the 1990s through the 2020s, and includes detailed sign specifications (for example, one-way arrows, curb lines, and property lines). Many fields are sparsely populated—coordinates are missing for over half the rows,
